metadata.comment: The game draws its own 3D school, side sheet and buttons in here (game/src/boot.js). Keep it childless: the game replaces its contents.

parameters.text: Le Gala de danse · on ouvre l'école…

metadata.comment: Every saved change, for the whole family: they live in the backend so they survive a cleared browser, another computer and a new version of the game.

nodes.label: Start the game with the grown-ups' changes

metadata.comment: Each saved change is checked again with the same rule book the server uses (scripts/gala/rows.js) and against this version's rows, so a change that no longer fits is skipped rather than breaking the game. When the backend can't be reached, the last changes this computer saw are used.
A full page load on purpose, both ways: the game starts again from scratch with the newest changes, and its 3D loop and keyboard shortcuts don't linger behind the settings.
